# Getting help

- **How do I…?** Look in the [user manual](https://audiostrada.com/manual/), then ask in
  [Discussions › Q&A](https://github.com/audiostrada/audiostrada/discussions/categories/q-a).
- **Something does not work**: open a [bug report](https://github.com/audiostrada/audiostrada/issues/new/choose).
- **A plugin misbehaves**: open a plugin compatibility report.
- **Licence, subscription or payment**: [audiostrada.com/subscription](https://audiostrada.com/subscription),
  or contact@audiostrada.com.
